rationale: Standard tier approved before any seat was dispatched: three actor seats, no evidence seat and no red-team seat, because this run is the Mode B arm of a bounded comparison and those stages define Modes C and D. Recorded here so the authorisation is an entity rather than a claim in prose.
note: Actor decomposition justified from facts, not priors: Intel leadership (FACT-001, FACT-003), German federal government (FACT-002, FACT-004), Saxony-Anhalt (FACT-002). The EU Commission was folded into the German party's constraints because it took no independent action inside the window.
